title: H2 masked attachment-line transfers and complete SRAM-backed 720p automatic continuation
scope: Attachment-only word/line gather-scatter integrated with two SRAM slots per render engine, native bins/continuation and shared CUs/L2/Sv32. Functional hardware development and H0-H8 gates remain incomplete. A follow-up fixes response-ready selection in the validation composition; main RTL and synthesis emissions remain unchanged.
current_stage_ppa_policy: User selected synthesis-only PPA; no new place/route runs.
emission_command: sbt -J-Xmx8G -batch 'runMain opengpu.elaboration.EmitPpaRtl mobile-attachment-line-port generated/mobile-h2/attachment-line-port-v1-rtl' 'runMain opengpu.elaboration.EmitPpaRtl mobile-tile-double generated/mobile-h2/attachment-line-double-v1-rtl' 'runMain opengpu.elaboration.EmitPpaRtl mobile-tile-double-legacy generated/mobile-h2/attachment-line-legacy-v1-rtl' 'runMain opengpu.elaboration.EmitPpaRtl mobile-continuing-bin-render generated/mobile-h2/attachment-line-render-v1-rtl' > .artifacts/mobile-attachment-line-emission-v1.log 2>&1

attachment_line_port.packing: Merge disjoint aligned words only into an open line. Seal at full mask, full unsealed gathering credit window, read hazard, group pressure or 32 idle cycles. Offered payload is immutable; unmasked data words are zero.
attachment_line_port.response: Retain one address and exactly one acknowledgement per accepted word. Capture independently reordered line responses, expand masked write replies, and hold each word reply/fault under backpressure. Reserve read progress even with all write replies held.
attachment_line_port.read_cache: Four fully associative pass-local lines cover color/depth at two quad rows. Registered tag-hit/word-return path; successful fills only. Writes invalidate matching lines; every begin requires drain and invalidates all lines.
attachment_line_port.abort: Sticky cancel/execution fault or line fault stops new external work. Drop only unoffered work with synthetic drain replies; retain offered/issued line ownership until acknowledgement. A late fault retains priority; faulted reads never cache zero.
attachment_line_port.ownership: Slot completion requires both child completion and full line-port drain. No tile/VM rebind or ID reuse before accepted/offered ownership and all word replies drain.
attachment_line_port.counters: Requested sourced read words count four useful load bytes on reply; stores/resolves count actual issued byte-mask bytes, including faulted issued requests. Cache hits count logical loads but no line fill. Dropped unoffered work adds no external store bytes. Store bytes include resolve bytes; these counters are not full 64-byte bus traffic.

storage.accounting: Major-array budget adds 1 KiB for four cache lines per slot over two engines/two slots. Gather queues, reply data, tags, masks, IDs and control remain additional registered state. Current attachment SRAM is 16 KiB/engine, versus the proposed 64 KiB/engine.

word_port.caveat: Controlled latency and credit model; simulator cycles only. This is not a DRAM, whole-frame, power or FPS measurement.

real_sram_export.caveat: Controlled latency and credit model; simulator cycles only. This is not a DRAM, whole-frame, power or FPS measurement.

transfer_benchmarks.real_sram_scope: One 16x16 RGBA8+D24S8 tile, lazy clear plus 32 patterned color/depth updates. Both variants export all 512 words exactly, 2048 useful bytes, zero old attachment reads; one external write credit and identical 80-cycle response service.
transfer_benchmarks.read_reuse: 64 contiguous or quad-working-set word reads require four line fills and 60 hits; exact values, write invalidation and owner rebinding are checked.

low_latency_tradeoff.scope: The small 16x8 4x-MSAA continued workload uses low synthetic memory latency. Buffered read/reply latency increases cycles versus the earlier frozen source. The credit-limited export speedup is not universal.

complete_720p_automatic_continuation.scope: One public begin, input each of 27 ordered references once, hardware drains/reloads/retries internally. Every (batch,tile) event is unique, empty untouched visits have zero attachment traffic, and all 1843200 final RGBA8/D24S8 words match uninterrupted unbinned RTL.
complete_720p_automatic_continuation.oracle_limit: Reference uses a separate unbinned renderer with shared raster/arithmetic/pixel backend implementation; not an independent GLES semantic oracle or a representative dense full-frame throughput qualification.

shared_sv32.validation_limit: The frozen 312-check composition used unqualified OR-of-ready response selection. The attached follow-up corrects it, checks all 8192 ready-selection combinations and reruns all five affected actual shared-CU image/fault/reuse cases. Production host integration remains open.
shared_sv32.scope: Actual shared CUs, coherent L2 and Sv32. Complete healthy images match, both engine clients execute shaders; roots/backing change only between public submissions.

functional_follow_up.correction: Gate common response ready by the response transaction-ID range. Assert each accepted common response fires exactly one selected downstream client. An unrelated ready client cannot consume a selected-client stall.
functional_follow_up.scope: The earlier frozen 312-check full regression is retained. Only its shared-system validation composition changes; all five affected image/fault/reuse cases are rerun, together with one new exhaustive ready-selection check. This is 313 unique checks across the two recorded source snapshots, not one 313-check invocation.
